subject: general
question: Who among the following presides over the joint sitting of the two Houses of Parliament?

options.text: Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**Speaker of the Lok Sabha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The Speaker of the Lok Sabha **presides over the joint sitting of the two Houses of Parliament.
 
• Article 108 of the Indian Constitution of India provides for a Joint sitting of both Houses.
 
• A joint session can be summoned: 
 
 
• If a bill is passed by one House and transmitted to the other House&nbs
